prompt: Bug report from a user: "On my GPS track, which has a lot of small up-and-down noise, the days from `trailhead plan` add up to 9h 40m, but `trailhead summary` says 7h 05m for the same file. The README says the two should agree." Find the cause and fix it.
bash_commands: git status --short && git ls-files && cat README.md 2>/dev/null | head -150

cd /tmp/claude-1000/-home-manushev-GitHub-python-articles-writer/c00e7a54-fe2c-45eb-bf41-847a467f2d01/scratchpad/work/haiku-h05-r1/src/trailhead && cat plan.py elevation.py && grep -n "ascent\|gain\|naismith\|def " cli.py report.py geo.py pace.py track.py | head -80

cd /tmp/claude-1000/-home-manushev-GitHub-python-articles-writer/c00e7a54-fe2c-45eb-bf41-847a467f2d01/scratchpad/work/haiku-h05-r1 && cat src/trailhead/pace.py && sed -n 1,60p src/trailhead/report.py && cat tests/test_plan.py && grep -n "leg_hours" -r src tests
cat tests/test_pace.py tests/conftest.py && python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3

cat src/trailhead/cli.py | sed -n 1,80p && mkdir -p $TMPDIR/repro && python - <<'EOF'
import os
lines=["# name: jitter","lat,lon,ele"]
import math
lat=42.0
ele=1000.0
for i in range(400):
    lon=23.0+i*0.0005
    # gentle 0.5 km-ish slope with 2 m noise each point
    noise = 2.0 if i%2==0 else -2.0
    lines.append(f"{lat},{lon:.6f},{ele+noise:.1f}")
open(os.environ["TMPDIR"]+"/repro/jitter.csv","w").write("\n".join(lines)+"\n")
EOF
PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead summary $TMPDIR/repro/jitter.csv; PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead plan $TMPDIR/repro/jitter.csv
cat src/trailhead/cli.py

mkdir -p ./.repro && cat > ./.repro/make_jitter.py <<'EOF'
lines = ["# name: jitter", "lat,lon,ele"]
for i in range(1500):
    noise = 2.0 if i % 2 == 0 else -2.0       # GPS jitter around a gentle slope
    ele = 1000.0 + i * 0.4 + noise            # real climb: 600 m over the track
    lines.append(f"42.0,{23.0 + i * 0.0005:.6f},{ele:.1f}")
open("./.repro/jitter.csv", "w").write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
EOF
python ./.repro/make_jitter.py && PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead summary ./.repro/jitter.csv && PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead plan ./.repro/jitter.csv

mkdir -p .repro && python -c "
lines = ['# name: jitter', 'lat,lon,ele']
for i in range(1500):
    noise = 2.0 if i % 2 == 0 else -2.0
    ele = 1000.0 + i * 0.4 + noise
    lines.append(f'42.0,{23.0 + i * 0.0005:.6f},{ele:.1f}')
open('.repro/jitter.csv', 'w').write('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
" && PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead summary .repro/jitter.csv && PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead plan .repro/jitter.csv

python -c "
lines = ['# name: flat-jitter', 'lat,lon,ele']
for i in range(1500):
    ele = 1000.0 + (2.0 if i % 2 == 0 else -2.0)
    lines.append(f'42.0,{23.0 + i * 0.0005:.6f},{ele:.1f}')
open('.repro/flat.csv', 'w').write('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
" && PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead summary .repro/flat.csv && PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead plan .repro/flat.csv

python -c "
import random
random.seed(1)
lines = ['# name: noisy', 'lat,lon,ele']
for i in range(1500):
    ele = 1000.0 + i * 0.1 + random.uniform(-1.5, 1.5)
    lines.append(f'42.0,{23.0 + i * 0.0005:.6f},{ele:.1f}')
open('.repro/noisy.csv', 'w').write('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
" && PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead summary .repro/noisy.csv && PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead plan .repro/noisy.csv

PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead summary .repro/noisy.csv && PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead plan .repro/noisy.csv && python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; (ruff check 2>&1 | tail -2); (mypy 2>&1 | tail -2)
PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead summary .repro/noisy.csv && PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead plan .repro/noisy.csv
python -m pytest -q
ruff check; mypy
python -m pytest -q && ruff check && mypy && git stash push -q -- src && python -m pytest -q tests/test_plan.py 2>&1 | tail -2; git stash pop -q && rm -rf .repro && git status --short src tests
python -m pytest -q; ruff check; mypy

cp src/trailhead/pace.py .repro_pace.bak 2>/dev/null; cp src/trailhead/pace.py $TMPDIR/pace_new.py && git show HEAD:src/trailhead/pace.py > src/trailhead/pace.py && python -m pytest -q tests/test_plan.py 2>&1 | tail -2; cp $TMPDIR/pace_new.py src/trailhead/pace.py && rm -f .repro_pace.bak && python -m pytest -q | tail -1 && rm -rf .repro && git diff --stat
cp src/trailhead/pace.py .repro/pace_fixed.py && git show HEAD:src/trailhead/pace.py > src/trailhead/pace.py && python -m pytest -q tests/test_plan.py 2>&1 | tail -2
cp .repro/pace_fixed.py src/trailhead/pace.py && rm -rf .repro && python -m pytest -q | tail -1 && ruff check && mypy && git diff --stat
git diff src/trailhead/pace.py
